description: Sets which phase the room of a webinar shows right now: countdown, live, replay or closed. Side effect: every participant sees the new phase at once on the connected WordPress site; the campaign itself is not published or unpublished and no page is rebuilt. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id` from wi_list_webinars and `status`. `confirm` must be true, and only after the host has clearly agreed: a room that jumps to live is visible to everyone. A replay without a recording is refused by the site with a plain reason. Report the phase the answer reads back, never the phase you asked for.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said yes to this phase.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

status.description: The phase the room should show now.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_room
title: Switch the room phase of a webinar
